She is dressed in a light purple ribbed camisole and a thick white knit cardigan worn loosely off her shoulders. She initially faces away from the camera, gazing at the traditional Japanese-style dark wooden buildings and the clear water of the stream flowing beneath her. (2) The woman turns her head over her right shoulder to look directly into the camera lens. Her long hair is partially tied back with a small bow, flowing down her back. She breaks into a gentle, soft smile while her body remains angled away from the camera. The background reveals a mix of bare winter trees and evergreen pines under bright, diffused natural daylight. (3) Pivoting her entire torso, she faces the camera fully, exhibiting a bright and cheerful smile with clear eye contact. The camera framing tightens into a medium close-up, highlighting her facial features and the knit texture of her clothing. The stone railing of the bridge and the rippling water of the canal remain visible in the lower half of the frame as the scene concludes.
